title: mediation/0.1
description: Profile for mediation analyses, whether from regressions, two-stage (instrumental-variables) regressions or an SEM: R mediation (Imai, Keele, Tingley and Yamamoto; mediate, mediate_tsls), lavaan defined parameters (:=), PROCESS, Stata sem with estat teffects, StataNow mediate, Stata ivmediate; Python pingouin mediation_analysis and statsmodels Mediation (survey 2026-10-25, spec/profiles/mediation.md). Two-stage designs record their instruments and which variable they instrument. Requires specification.mediation with treatment, mediators and outcome, and the inference method (bootstrap, quasi-Bayesian simulation, delta/Sobel, Monte Carlo) with its replications and CI type; metrics.nobs; and at least one row whose mediation.effect is an indirect effect. Effect rows need estimate and either std_error or a confidence interval: R mediation reports no standard errors. No vcov is required, since bootstrap tools often report none. An SEM-based record also claims sem/0.1.

treatment.description: Treatment or focal predictor (X); a list when the model has several predictors of interest.

x-tools.indirect_boot: inferred from the sem model: variables that are only predictors, minus controls()

mediators.description: Mediator(s) (M); several for parallel or serial models.

models.description: How the mediator and outcome models were fit: [{response, estimator, formula}], or "sem". estimator ols, tsls, logit, ... (StataNow mediate: each model's family).

instruments.description: Excluded instruments in a two-stage (IV) mediation design.

x-tools.mediate_tsls: regressors of model.m that are not in model.y

instrumented.description: Which variable the instruments stand in for.

x-tools.mediate_tsls: mediator (the outcome model uses its first-stage fitted values)
x-tools.ivmediate: treatment (e(treat)); the mediator is identified from the same instrument, conditional on the treatment (Dippel et al.)

interaction.description: Treatment-mediator interaction in the outcome model.

x-tools.StataNow mediate: e(tvartype); continuous() lists the evaluation points, the first being the control

x-tools.mediate_tsls: boot (FALSE: aroian, Aroian 1947 product SE; TRUE: bootstrap)
x-tools.StataNow mediate: analytic by default; vce(robust), vce(cluster), vce(bootstrap), vce(jackknife); nose

x-tools.indirect_boot: cis() (bca; normal, percentile, bc, all) via estat bootstrap
seed() (12345: the same seed every run unless set)

robust.description: Robust or clustered SEs in the underlying models.

x-tools.mediate_tsls: always sandwich::vcovCL: with cluster = NULL each row is its own cluster (HC1-type), so robustSE has no effect

effect_row.description: Which effect a row is. a and b are paths; indirect = a x b (or ACME); direct = c'; total = c.

x-tools.mediation: d0, d1, d.avg (acme_*); z0, z1, z.avg (ade_*); tau.coef (total); n0, n1, n.avg (prop_mediated_*)
x-tools.statsmodels: ACME (control/treated/average), ADE (...), Total effect, Prop. mediated (...)
x-tools.pingouin: paths: "M ~ X" (a), "Y ~ M" (b), Total, Direct, Indirect
x-tools.StataNow mediate: nie (indirect), nde (direct), te (total) by default; pnie (pure_indirect), tnde (total_direct), pomeans (potential_outcome_mean); aite, adte, ate, aitec, adtet are ATE-terminology synonyms (ateterms)
x-tools.mediate_tsls: d0 = d1 (indirect), z0 = z1 (direct), tau.coef (total), n0 (prop_mediated), each with .se
x-tools.ivmediate: e(b): total, direct and indirect effects; e(mepct) = indirect / total x 100

mediator.description: Mediator this effect goes through (specific indirect effects).

treatment.description: Predictor the effect starts from, when the model has several.

path.description: Serial paths: the variables in order.

moderator_value.description: Conditional indirect effect at this moderator value.
